buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 2. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support.

3. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 6. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Executive Engineer, Irrigation Mechanical Division No-2,Ukai A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

1 EMD Yes, 3% Bidders can also submit the EMD with Acc ount Payee Demand Draft (Pay Order and Bank Guarantee only from banks approve d by Finance Department, Gujarat is allo wed as per Gujarat Purchase policy 2024 Clause No 4(B)) In favour of Executive Eng ineer, Irrigation Mechanical Division No-2, Ukai Payable at Ukai. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcop y to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End dat e/ Bid Opening date. EMD Exemption will be provided to the bid der having “UdyamAadhar” registration along with CSPO/NSIC/ D.G.S. & D. Regi stration as per Gujarat Govt. purchase poli cy 2016. But such bidders have to submit the Bid Security Declaration form compuls orily as per GR No:F.9/4/2020-PPD Govern ment of India Ministry of Expenditure proc urement policy division dated 12-11-2020 (Bid Security Declaration Form Attached) Only UdyamAdhar registration will not be considered for EMD exemption.

2 Bidder Turnover Crite Yes. ria The minimum average annual financial tur nover of the bidder during the last three y ears, ending on 31 March of the previous f inancial year should be greater than or eq ual to 200% of the bid estimated value as indicated in the bid document. Document ary evidence in the form of certified Audit ed Balance Sheet of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant/ Cost Accountant indicating the turnover d etails for the relevant period shall be uplo aded with the bid. In case the date of cons titution/incorporation of the bidder is less t han 3 year old, the average turnover in re spect of the completed financial years aft er the date of constitution shall be taken i nto account for these criteria. 3 Project Experience sh Yes. ould be validated The bidder must have executed at least o ne single order of 55% value of the bid or 2 orders each of 35% value of the bid or 3 orders each of 30% value of the bid for si milar service(s) in last three financial year s (i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25,2025-26) to any Central/ State Govt. Organization / PSU / P ublic limited Company. Satisfactory Perfor mance certificate issued by respective Bu yer Organization for the above Orders sho uld be uploaded with bid. In case of bunch bids, the Category related to primary prod uct having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 4 Experience Criteria The Service Provider is required to have a t least 20% of Similar Man power ( i.e. Skil led Person-1 No & Un Skilled Person-03 No ) on Service Provider’s pay roll for at least Eleven (11) Months out of last three finan cial years. Necessary Documents ( i.e. Lis t of Manpower with UAN of 11 months & E PF Slip of manpower shown in List of 11 m onths as proof is mandatory such manpow er will be uploaded by the bidder for verifi cation of the buyer. Such manpower will b e part of total manpower to be provided b y the Service Provider in case he gets the contract against this Bid.

5 Bidder financial stand The Bidder should not be under liquidation ing , court receivership or similar proceeding should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking in the form of latest (for Year- 2026) notarized Affidavit to this effect wit h bid. 6 T.A /D.A. T.A./D.A. or any other Extra allowances to contracted staff will not be paid by the Bu yer/Consignee. 7 Details of Consignee Deputy Executive Engineer, Irrigation Mec hanical Sub Division No-2/1,Ukai. Deputy Executive Engineer, Irrigation Mec hanical Sub Division No-2/2,Ukai. Deputy Executive Engineer, Irrigation Mec hanical Sub Division No-2/3,Surat. 8 TDS of GST As per G.R. No. GST/1017/1097/GST / Cell dated 15/09/2018 TDS for GST at the rate of 2% (1% SGST & 1% CGST) will be deduc ted from every bill of Contract and certific ate for same shall be issued. 9 TDS for Income Tax As per prevailing Government Rules, TDS for income tax at rate of 2% will be deduct ed from every bill of Contract and certifica te for same shall be issued. 10 Registered Active PA The PAN must be active during the bid su N bmission and throughout the execution of bid else TDS will be deducted as per preva iling Rule.

11 Emergency Services The service provider has to provide altern ate staff immediately without fail even on weekly off or public holidays in Emergenc y or any abnormal situation. In Case of emergency/forced circumstanc es, natural calamities, etc., the agency sh all immediately provide the required Man power as per the requirement. The requir ement of Manpower will be communicated to the agency through SMS/email, a confir mation copy of which will be given to the agency. The time period mentioned will be calculated from the date of SMS/email. Th e time period from the receipt of the confi rmation post will not be taken into consideration. In case of failure to send th e Manpower as per the time period or failu re of the Manpower to appear, charges of one and a half times (1 1/2%) of the price paid for each day of delay beyond the sai d time period (Day-2) shall be deposited b y the agency in this office or treasury on D ay-3. In case of any default, the said amou nt will be deducted from the bill. In such a case, it will be mandatory for the agency t o pay the minimum wages as per the Mini mum Wages Act to the number of drivers/ operators who have provided services in t hat month. Failure to do so will result in th e agency being fully responsible for all ma tters related to the Labour Act and the Min imum Wages Act. There will be no scope f or any dispute, controversy, arbitration or compensation in this regard.

12 Scope of work of age Scope of work for Fitter, Electrician & Wel ncy der is to carry out General Repairing Work of Machinery/Vehicle like Excavator, Dozer , Back Hoe Loader, Truck, Crane, D.G. Set and other similar Type Machineries and eq uipment At HMR Workshop or at Section/ Workshop/Site to any site of work under th e Ex. Engr. Irri. Mech. Dn. No. 2 Ukai. Scope of work for Helper is to assistance i n Maintenance-Repairing work of Machine ries/Vehicles, Diesel Collection Distribution works and store management works and o ther Site work at Section/Workshop/Site to any site of work under the Ex. Engr. Irri. M ech. Dn. No. 2 Ukai. Fitter, Electrician, Welder & Helper will be required as per requirement on Site/Sectio n or any other work as required. They will be relieved immediately after completion of said work. 13 Legal Jurisdiction Jurisdiction will be at the Tapi District. 14 Additional Deposit for Successful bidder has to pay an Additional probable damages to Deposit in form of Fixed Deposit Receipt(F T&P. DR) of Amounting 25,000/- Rs. of Schedul ed Nationalized Bank for probable damag es to Machineries, Vehicles, Pumps, Tools etc. due to In dexterity, Negligence, Carel essness, Intentional Effort of deployed per sons during Operation-Maintenance-Repai r Work of thereof. FDR should be made ou t or pledged in the name of Executive Engi neer, Irrigation Mechanical Division No-2,U kai at Ukai and should be valid for whole d uration of Contract. In the event of any theft, pilferage, loss, d amage or injury, to the properties at Site d ue to negligence or omission of duty com mitted by any of the personnel of the age ncy, the agency shall be held liable for all the loss/damage and in such event the Off ice can claim the value of such loss/dama ge from the agency.

15 Accidental Insurance Successful bidder has to mandatorily insur e every person from the first day of deplo yment under cover of Personal Accident (P A)/Group Personal Accident (GPA) Insuran ce Policy of Sum Insured not less than 3 la kh per person and same should be valid fo r whole duration of work of that person(s) for Accident arise during work, if any. Extr a Payment shall not be given to service pr ovider for this Accidental Insurance Cover. Hence, every bidder has to bid accordingl y by considering relevant expenses in this regard.

16 Purchase Preference ( Purchase preference will be given to MSE State) s from the State of Bid Inviting Authority having valid Udyam Registration and who se credentials are validated online throug h Udyam Registration portal as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and S mall Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 date d 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued b y concerned Ministry / State of Bid invitin g authority. If the bidder wants to avail th emselves of the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer / OEM o f the offered product on GeM. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Proc urement Policy for Micro and Small Enter prises and hence resellers offering produ cts manufactured by some other OEM are not eligible for any purchase preference. I n respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offere d Service. Relevant documentary evidenc e in this regard shall be uploaded along w ith the bid in respect of the offered produ ct or service and Buyer will decide eligibili ty for purchase preference based on docu mentary evidence submitted, while evalu ating the bid. If L-1 is not an MSE and MS E Seller (s) has / have quoted price within L-1+ 20 % of margin of purchase prefere n c e /price band defined in relevant policy, such MSE Seller shall be given opp ortunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for 100 percentage of tot al quantity. The buyers are advised to ref er the OM No.F.1/4/2021-PPDb dated 18.05.2023 OM_No.1 _4_2021_ PPD_date d_18 .05 .2023 for compliance of Concurr ent application of Public Procurement Poli cy for Micro and Small Enterprises Order, 2012 and Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order, 2017. Benefits of MSE will be allowed only if seller is validated on-line in GeM profile as well as validated and approved by Buyer after ev aluation of documents submitted.

17 Extension of time limi 1. Duration of service contract may be t extended up to 11(Eleven) month or more as per circumstances and requi rements beyond the initial contract d uration subject to satisfactory perfor mance and mutual consent. 2. For Extended time period the rate wil l be as per prevailing min. wages ra te. 18 If ESI Not Applicable Agency Shall Have to cover deploy person under workman compensation act insuran ce policy where ever ESI act is not applica ble. Necessary action should be taken by agency. 19 Over Time The overtime payment will be provided du ring the quarter as per Govt. Gazette dat. 07/03/2019. A prescribed register has to maintain by the agency. Agency will pay first the overtime charges to outsource staff and will be claim to con cerned office by submitting the record. Ag ency will not be eligible for any service ch arges on this payment. While generating invoice in GEM portal th 20. GST Payment Proof e seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal c onfirming payment of GST. 21 Subletting of contract 1. The Seller shall not assign the contract in whole or part. 2. The seller shall not sub-contract the Co ntract in whole or part to any entity. Bidder Must quote service charges(in %) b 22 Payment of Wages-All y considering all relevant expenses regard owances ing Wages-Allowances to be paid to contr acted staff, Group Insurance Cover, Additi onal Deposit for T&P & over overhead cha rges/profit of Agency during participation of bid. Also, assures that Bidder shall pay Wages-Allowances as per Rate Analysis gi ven by buyer/prevailing minimum wages a s per the Minimum Wages Act and deposit staff's contribution towards PF & ESI to res pective authorities regularly.

23 Option Clause The Purchaser reserves the right to increa se or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves t he right to increase the ordered quantity by up to 25% of the contracted quantity d uring the currency of the contract at the c ontracted rates.
